title: V3 cuff fit · PETG · single-plate slice review
subtitle: 3 separate pieces at 100% scale · petg-friction-fit-v1
notes: Supports occur only inside the cuff central key opening/recess (0.0182 g). Inspect removal access and clean the thin head-seat wall gently.
The two friction ribs are integral PETG geometry inside fit-jaw, not separate parts or removable supports. Jaw and key generated no support paths.
PETG is a rigid fit trial; intended later cuff material is ELEGOO TPU 95A. Use a dummy edge first and do not force a jammed key.
Current 12.2 mm shared key retained by user choice. Holding force and thin-head strength remain untested. No print sent.
